verdict.rationale: 1Password's Watchtower is documented as flagging breaches, weak passwords, and duplicate (reused) items among saved logins, which covers the core of this story. The only source is one first-party sentence, though. It does not document proactive warnings, and it does not separately confirm detection of individually exposed or compromised passwords. Missing for 10: documented proactive alerts or notifications when a breach occurs, explicit detection of exposed or compromised individual passwords, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, the app warns me when a service I use is breached or a stored credential is weak, reused, or exposed

citations.quote: Watchtower tells you about breaches, weak passwords, duplicate items, and other security problems with the items you have saved in 1Password.
